steps: Tests it in the running game
scenes.say: Point Claude Code, Codex or Gemini at a game you own. It reads the real code, builds the mod, makes the art and sound, and tests it in-game.

pros: Works with most AI coding agents
scenes.say: The catch: art and sound use fal, which is pay as you go, and it only mods single-player games you own. The project itself is free and open source.
Which game would you mod first? Comment MOD and I'll pin the link.

youtube.description:
AI mods PC games now: Universal Modder is a free, open-source plugin that lets Claude Code, Codex or Gemini mod single-player games you own. It reads the real game code, builds the mod, makes art and sound, and tests it in-game.
The catch: art, 3D and sound use fal (pay-as-you-go).
Repo: github.com/rehan-remade/universal-modder (MIT). Footage: the repo's official teaser.
